# Knowledge

This project's guidance and documents, for people and agents: how files here are organised and written, how agents work, domains, plans and findings. Procedures live in `.agents/skills/`. `meta/`, `agents/`, `setup.md` and `tools/` come with the framework; `product/`, domains, `specs/` and `reports/` are added when the project needs them, most through [set-up-project](../.agents/skills/set-up-project/SKILL.md).
